card.name: Opioid boxed-warning phrases before risk terms
card.fires_on: Small words like "similar" or "the" inside fixed opioid boxed-warning sentences, e.g. "exposes users to the risks of addiction" and "Because of similar pharmacological properties". Also the end of the heading "Addiction, Abuse, and Misuse".

modes.label: exposes users to the
modes.description: The word "the" after "As an opioid, [drug] exposes users to", before the risks of addiction, abuse, and misuse.
modes.example: As an opioid, nalbuphine exposes users to<< the>> risks of addiction, abuse, and misuse
